caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with four legs and a rectangular shape, presented at a slight angle so that both the front and a part of the left side are visible. The chest is dark brown in color and features carved floral designs on its front and side panels. The front of the chest is divided into three upper panels and one lower long horizontal panel. Each of the two outer upper panels displays a symmetrical floral motif, while the center upper panel has a circular decor with the letters "F L" and the year "1795" inscribed within it, encircled by smaller decorative elements. The lower front panel extends across the width of the chest and contains a series of vine-like carvings with leaves and berries. The left side of the chest is also decorated with floral carvings, matching the style of the front, and the chest appears to have a hinged lid on top, with a small keyhole at the center edge. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or beige color with some light stains, and the name "David Dorfman" is faintly written in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Chest
